description: File-size limits consumed by scripts/check_file_size_limits.py. Rules are ordered: first match wins. Every repository file must match a rule or an exemption.

rules.name: ai-guidance-markdown
rules.rationale: Always-loaded AI contracts and customization files stay compact; detail belongs in openspec/docs.

rules.name: ai-guidance-json
rules.rationale: AI governance JSON should remain reviewable and should not hide large policy bodies.

rules.name: python-test
rules.rationale: Test files may group business scenarios and fixtures, but should split above this point.

rules.name: python-source
rules.rationale: Production Python modules should remain small enough to preserve module boundaries and readability.

rules.name: django-template
rules.rationale: A page template above this size mixes regions; extract partials per region or tab.

rules.name: stylesheet
rules.rationale: Split CSS by component family or page (foundation/, shell/, pages/) and register files in ui_web/static_assets.py.

rules.name: browser-javascript
rules.rationale: Browser scripts split by feature module; one file must not accumulate unrelated page behavior.

rules.name: frontend-tooling
rules.rationale: Build and QA scripts stay single-purpose; shared helpers live in shared.mjs.

rules.name: javascript-test
rules.rationale: JavaScript tests follow the Python test cap; split by behavior family above it.

rules.name: frontend-config-json
rules.rationale: Design tokens and tool configuration stay reviewable; split token groups by tier before they sprawl.

rules.name: powershell
rules.rationale: Launcher and validation scripts split by lifecycle phase; dot-source shared helpers.

rules.name: markdown
rules.rationale: Documentation may be longer than AI guidance but must stay bounded enough to review explicitly.

rules.name: yaml
rules.rationale: Profiles and workflow definitions should stay declarative and small.

rules.name: json-data
rules.rationale: Checked-in configuration and planning data stay reviewable; generated exports are exempt by name.

rules.name: repository-config
rules.rationale: Repository and tool configuration files stay small and declarative.

rules.name: ai-guidance-assets
rules.rationale: Other AI customization assets (catalog pages, samples) follow the AI guidance cap.

exemptions.name: generated-or-cache-output
exemptions.reason: Generated, cache, lockfile, or local runtime artifacts are not reviewed by size.

exemptions.name: vendored-third-party
exemptions.reason: Pinned third-party bundles and notices produced by build scripts with hash manifests; never edited by hand.

exemptions.name: openspec-cli-generated
exemptions.reason: Generated by the OpenSpec CLI (metadata.generatedBy); refresh with openspec update instead of editing.

exemptions.name: grafana-dashboard-exports
exemptions.reason: Grafana dashboard models validated by scripts/validate_grafana_artifacts.py; edit ops/grafana/render_configs and regenerate.

exemptions.name: binary-and-image-assets
exemptions.reason: Binary, font, compiled-catalog, and icon assets have no line-count contract.

exemptions.name: translation-catalogs
exemptions.reason: Gettext catalogs are produced by makemessages and grow with the UI string inventory.

legacy_over_limit_allowances.name: legacy-report-editor-scripts
legacy_over_limit_allowances.reason: Owner: project reporting UI. Split plan: separate codec node families, editor bootstrap from toolbar wiring, template builder steps, and Milkdown plugin registration.

legacy_over_limit_allowances.name: legacy-ai-stack-launcher
legacy_over_limit_allowances.reason: Owner: local stack tooling. Split plan: move start, stop, and health phases into dot-sourced scripts under scripts/.

legacy_over_limit_allowances.name: legacy-python-modules
legacy_over_limit_allowances.reason: Owner: bug_metrics API and ui_web facades. Split plan: split AI context builders by section and the scope-config facade into read, preview, and save services.

exemption_principles: Prefer splitting source files over adding exemptions or allowances.
Exempt only generated, vendored, cache, binary, or external artifact files, each with a reason.
Every repository file must match a rule or an exemption; unclaimed files fail the gate.
Legacy allowances cover only files already over their cap, name an owner and a split plan, use max_added_lines 0 unless review approves more, and are deleted once the file is back under its cap.
